findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_signals, get_signal, get_signal_with_context, get_liquidation_map, get_economic_calendar, get_proof · Private data: list_signals, get_performance, get_usage, log_trade, get_journal, get_trust · Public sink: get_performance, get_mindshare, get_mindshare_coin, get_discovery, get_asset_class_proof, get_proof, get_narrative · Destructive: void_trade, get_trust.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_signals, get_signal, get_signal_with_context, get_liquidation_map, get_economic_calendar, get_proof · Private data: list_signals, get_performance, get_usage, log_trade, get_journal, get_trust · Public sink: get_performance, get_mindshare, get_mindshare_coin, get_discovery, get_asset_class_proof, get_proof, get_narrative · Destructive: void_trade, get_trust

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
